title: Sometimes We 'Spread Ourself Too Thin' (1/2)
titleZh: 有時候我們會「分身乏術」(1/2)
summaryZh: 本集談的是事情攬太多、把自己搞得分身乏術的英文說法。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Words and Their Stories

sentences.text: And now, words and their stories, from VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 接下來是 VOA 學習英語的「詞語故事」節目。

sentences.text: Today, we talk about our busy lives.
sentences.zh: 今天我們要聊聊忙碌的生活。

sentences.text: Many people have family and work responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 很多人都有家庭和工作要顧。

sentences.text: We might have religious or community activities.
sentences.zh: 我們可能還有宗教或社區活動要參加。

sentences.text: Taking care of our health is also important.
sentences.zh: 照顧好自己的健康也很重要。

sentences.text: And let's not forget about our personal projects, our interests, and our friendships.
sentences.zh: 還別忘了自己的計畫、興趣，還有朋友之間的往來。

sentences.text: With everything on our plate, it is easy to feel overwhelmed, overextended, and overcommitted.
sentences.zh: 手上一堆事情，很容易覺得喘不過氣、負荷過重、答應了太多。

sentences.text: However, if we try to do too much, we may spread ourselves too thin.
sentences.zh: 不過，如果什麼都想做，我們可能就會 spread ourselves too thin，也就是分身乏術。

sentences.text: This expression means we have taken on too much.
sentences.zh: 這個說法的意思是，我們承擔了太多事情。

sentences.text: We are pushed to the limit.
People who are spread too thin take on too many jobs, projects, or goals.
sentences.zh: 分身乏術的人，往往接了太多工作、專案或目標。

sentences.text: The heavy load requires more energy or attention than they possess.
sentences.zh: 這麼重的負擔，需要的精力和專注力超過他們能負荷的程度。

sentences.text: If we work on many projects simultaneously, or at the same time, it is possible that none will get done well, if they get done at all.
sentences.zh: 如果我們同時進行很多專案，結果可能沒有一件做得好，甚至根本做不完。

sentences.text: Being spread too thin can also be described as biting off more than we can chew.
sentences.zh: 分身乏術也可以說成 biting off more than we can chew，也就是貪多嚼不爛。

sentences.text: When we bite off more than we can chew, we attempt to do more than is possible.
sentences.zh: 當我們貪多嚼不爛時，就是想做的事超過自己能力所及。
